do.text: Hello {row.name}, your enrollment in {row.course.title} ({row.course.level}, {row.course.duration}) is confirmed. Certification path: {row.course.certification}

Course.title: Certified Ethical Hacking Foundations
Course.description: An entry-level course covering the attacker mindset, reconnaissance, scanning and reporting.
Course.syllabus: Week 1: security fundamentals. Week 2: reconnaissance and footprinting. Week 3: scanning and enumeration. Week 4: vulnerability analysis. Week 5: exploitation basics. Week 6: reporting and capstone lab.
Course.certification: On completion you earn the Institute's CEHF Foundation Badge, which counts as the first credit toward the Certified Ethical Hacker Professional (CEHP) track.

Course.title: Network Security Analyst
Course.description: Hardening networks, intrusion detection and firewall design for working administrators.
Course.syllabus: Week 1: TCP/IP security review. Week 2: firewalls and segmentation. Week 3: IDS/IPS. Week 4: VPNs. Week 5: wireless security. Week 6: monitoring and SIEM. Week 7: incident drills. Week 8: capstone assessment.
Course.certification: Graduates sit the Network Security Analyst (NSA) certification exam on the final day; passing grants the NSA credential and eligibility for the Security Operations track.

Course.title: Advanced Penetration Testing
Course.description: Hands-on offensive security: web, network and cloud penetration testing against realistic ranges.
Course.syllabus: Week 1: engagement scoping. Weeks 2-3: web application attacks. Weeks 4-5: network pivoting. Weeks 6-7: cloud and container attacks. Week 8: active directory attacks. Weeks 9-10: capstone red-team exercise.
Course.certification: Completion is the final requirement for the Certified Ethical Hacker Professional (CEHP) credential, the Institute's senior offensive-security certification.

Answer.question: What courses do you offer?
Answer.reply: We offer three programmes: Certified Ethical Hacking Foundations (beginner, 6 weeks), Network Security Analyst (intermediate, 8 weeks) and Advanced Penetration Testing (advanced, 10 weeks). See the course catalogue for full syllabi.

Answer.question: What are your batch timetables?
Answer.reply: Foundations runs online starting 2026-10-05 and again 2026-11-16; Network Security Analyst runs on campus starting 2026-10-12; Advanced Penetration Testing's next batch starts 2026-10-19 but is currently full. Open batches are shown on each course page.

Answer.question: How do I enrol?
Answer.reply: Open the course you want from the catalogue, review its batches, then use the Enrol form on the course page with your name, email and phone; you will get an emailed confirmation right away.

Answer.question: What certification will I get?
Answer.reply: Each course ends in its own credential: Foundations grants the CEHF badge, Network Security Analyst grants the NSA credential, and Advanced Penetration Testing completes the Certified Ethical Hacker Professional (CEHP) track. Details are on each course's page.

Answer.question: How can I contact the institute?
Answer.reply: Use the Contact page to send your name, email and message and our admissions team will get back to you.

pages.heading: Certification pathways
body: Every programme ends in its own credential, and the tracks build on each other.
Foundations (beginner) grants the CEHF badge and is the entry point into the offensive-security track.
Network Security Analyst (intermediate) grants the NSA credential for defenders and SOC analysts.
Advanced Penetration Testing (advanced) is the final requirement for the Certified Ethical Hacker Professional (CEHP) credential.
